text:
samir: Heads-up — provisioning hit a hard quota in eastus2. Need GPU SKU and NIC increases before next week's rollout.
samir: Subscription: sub-0a1b2c3d, region: eastus2. Target fleet: 48 A100-class nodes, ~2x scale buffer. Current GPU quota = 8. Network NIC quota = 120, need 400.
samir: Opened ticket with Azure earlier, case SR#2109876543 — asking for SKU quota bump and NIC limit change. cc @lucy @mateo
lucy: Thanks. We're scheduled to start canary on Mon. If quota isn't fixed we'll fallback to smaller region or reduce canary size.
lucy: Can you paste the exact SKU names you requested? Azure is picky.
samir: Requested: "Standard_ND96asr_v4" and "Standard_ND40rs_v2" (A100/large-GPU families). Also asked for "IP/NIC per subscription (eastus2)" increase to 600.
mateo: Uploaded required justification doc to the portal. Included expected sustained vCPU and GPU-hours, security review note, and estimated monthly cost bucket: infra-dedicated-prod.
mateo: Also added notes about planned autoscale behavior and that we'll use reserved capacity for Dedicated customers.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: created internal ticket INFRA-1138 to track cloud quota work, linked SR#2109876543.
jessica: FYI finance flagged the cost delta for 600 NICs — we need approval from cost-ops. I pinged @finance to confirm.
az-support-bot: Update on SR#2109876543 — assigned to Tier 2. Initial review complete. Quota specialist requested subscription verification docs. ETA 36-48h after docs accepted.
samir: Docs submitted: subscription verification + network design spreadsheet. Link: https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_Azure_Support/CaseOverview/id/2109876543
lucy: If Azure can't commit, fallback plan: deploy into westus3 with existing quotas and throttle rollout to 12-node canary. Not ideal for latency testing.
mateo: Can we also request burst capacity for Dedicated in westus3 as contingency? I'll add to the case.
samir: Added a note to SR to include westus3 as standby. Also requested expedited escalation citing customer-impact risk.
az-support-bot: SR#2109876543 — Partial approval granted for GPU SKU counts in eastus2 up to 40 nodes pending background checks. NIC increase still under review.
jessica: Great progress. Please add an explicit ask for NICs tied to VM count (400 NICs) — that helped in previous cases.
samir: Done. Noted to Azure: mapping of nodes->NICs, example: 48 nodes x 8 NICs/node = 384 (rounded to 400).
lucy: Once NICs approved, I'll schedule canary. If only GPUs are approved, we'll start limited run to validate model performance.
mateo: Marking INFRA-1138 in progress. Will update nightly until resolved.
az-support-bot: Final update SR#2109876543 — Full quota increases approved. GPUs: 100 A100-class SKUs; NICs: 800 for eastus2. Support case closed.
samir: Amazing, thanks team. Leaving this thread open until infra ticket INFRA-1138 is closed and we've validated deployments.
jessica: Confirmed finance sign-off for the increased quota cost. Moving to budget code infra-prod-q2.
infra-bot: INFRA-1138 -> resolved, closing after smoke runs. :tada:
